question: Does an Ettin-17M multi-head student without spaCy keep every layer gate while cutting encoder time per window?

method.name: LLM-teacher distillation into a small multi-task encoder, int8 ONNX

stop: Stop after 2 backbone variants x 3 seeds if neither keeps every dev layer within 0.01 of v2.
risk_first: Export Ettin-17M with 5 heads to ONNX and confirm ORT int8 runs before training.
selection_rule: Pick the variant with the highest dev minimum-layer F1; ties -> lower encoder ms.
